chunks: And We have preserved it from every accursed devil,
ai.seo_question: How was the Quran preserved from the devils?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as affirming the divine preservation of the Quranic text from external corruption by devils, complementing the concept of infallible interpretation through the Ahl al-Bayt. The term 'shaytan rajim' emphasizes the exclusion of both jinn and human devils from distorting the message, ensuring the integrity of the revelation for the faithful.
